title: Getting music into the shop
target: How to put music into a Supermarket Simulator shop using the player, the speakers and the tab the game already provides.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A spot customers actually walk past

steps.do: Decide where the speakers go before you buy them.
steps.because: speakers are placed objects with a manager of their own (SpeakerManager)

steps.do: Set what is playing at the computer rather than expecting it to change itself.
steps.because: the music player has a tab among the management screens (MusicPlayerTab)

steps.do: Check that a speaker you have placed is set up, not merely switched on.
steps.because: the game keeps a record for a speaker of its own (SpeakerSO)

steps.do: Expect the choice to be shared in a joint shop.
steps.because: the music player is carried on the network (NetworkMusicPlayerManager)

steps.do: Plan speakers as fittings rather than as an afterthought.
steps.because: they are ordinary electrical devices like the rest (ElectricalDevice)

commonMistakes: Buying speakers and putting them where nobody walks.
Looking for the track list in settings rather than at the computer.
Expecting each player to hear something different.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
